subject: Pilot-Plus: sprint window adjustment & packaging proposal
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@lumera.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: poc@lumera.ai
Date: 2026-12-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick ask — short runway add-on and packaging question

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the excellent onboarding session yesterday — the Redwood integration with our inference pipeline is looking very promising. We have one ask before our internal exec review next week: the engineering team hit a larger-than-expected data prep task and we could use an extra 3 weeks on the pilot window to validate steady-state latency with a larger corpus.

Two quick asks: can you (1) extend our pilot sprint by 3 weeks (same scope, same throughput), and (2) clarify whether there is a short-term discount available if we agree to convert to a dedicated Small pool within 30 days of the pilot end? Budget is tight for this fiscal quarter, so any flexibility helps.

We want to avoid invoice churn — if you can propose a simple one-page amendment or a convertible credit approach that makes procurement easier, that'd be ideal.

Attaching our updated SOW with the extended dates for your reference.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of ML Ops | Lumera.ai

Attachment: Lumera_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumera.ai>
Cc: poc@lumera.ai, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway add-on and packaging question

Hi Elena — appreciate the heads-up and glad the integration went well.

Short answer: yes, we can add a 3-week sprint window to the pilot. I can do two packaging paths which usually help procurement teams:

- Convertible credit: we add 3 weeks and issue a pilot credit equivalent to the daily run-rate; if Lumera converts to Redwood Dedicated Small within 30 days, the credit is applied to the first invoice.
- Time-extension addendum: we extend the pilot dates by 3 weeks and invoice the incremental run-rate pro-rata (no conversion credit).

For budget-conscious customers we typically pair the convertible credit with a small conversion discount (5–10%) to the first month of committed capacity. To move quickly, I can send a 1-page amendment for the convertible-credit path and a pricing table.

Two internal notes: we’d need AE sign-off for any discount >5% and finance approval for convertible-credit accounting. Ben, can you confirm whether we have margin room for a 7% conversion credit + 3-week pilot credit? If not, I’ll propose a 5% conversion incentive and the credit option.

If that works, Elena, I’ll follow up with the amendment and a DocuSign link today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot-plus-pricing.xlsx (xlsx)
From: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot-Plus request — margin check

Vanessa — quick read: Lumera is mid-market and looks likely to convert; a modest incentive is reasonable. Margin math: 3-week pilot credit (pro-rata) + 7% off first monthly Dedicated invoice eats ~6% gross margin vs baseline, but we can make it up with a 12-month commit. Approve 7% only if AE has a verbal commitment to a 12-month Small pool within the 30-day conversion window.

If AE can't get that, default to 5% + convertible credit (no deeper discount). Also confirm ops that Dedicated Small capacity is available in us-west for January start.

Marissa — loop Ops for capacity check and Legal for a one-page amendment template we can reuse.

Thanks,
Ben
VP Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumera.ai>
Cc: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot-Plus: sprint window adjustment & packaging proposal

Elena — thanks for patience. We ran this internally and propose the following simple path to avoid procurement friction while giving Lumera budget certainty: 

Option A (recommended): Pilot-Plus convertible credit + 5% conversion incentive
- Add 3 weeks to the current pilot (new end date: 2027-01-09).
- Redwood issues a pilot credit equal to the cost of the extra 3 weeks. Credit is held for 90 days.
- If Lumera converts to a Redwood Dedicated Small pool within 30 days after the pilot end date, Redwood applies the pilot credit to the first invoice and provides a 5% discount on the first month.
- No additional invoicing during the extended pilot period.

Option B: Time-extension addendum (no credit)
- Extend pilot by 3 weeks and invoice the pro-rata amount for the added period. No conversion discount.

Operational notes: Ops confirmed Dedicated Small capacity is available in us-west for a Jan 2027 start. Legal provided a one-page amendment template (we attached for your procurement team).

Next steps: If you choose Option A, I’ll send the convertible-credit amendment and a DocuSign link. If you want a 7% incentive instead of 5%, Ben flagged we’d need a verbal commitment to a 12-month Small pool before we finalize.

I attached the one-page amendment and the pricing worksheet. Let me know which option you prefer and I’ll get the DocuSign out today.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the momentum.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical

Attachments: Lumera_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), pilot-plus-pricing.xlsx (xlsx), one-page-amendment-pilot-plus.docx (docx)
